items.title: Privacy Policy
items.content:
Last Updated: 28 Sep, 2026

HerbalVan (“HerbalVan”, “we”, “us”, or “our”) respects your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how information is handled when you visit and use the HerbalVan website (“Website”).

Our Website is primarily a product showcase and informational website. We do not currently provide account creation, checkout, payment processing, or direct online purchasing through the Website.

1. Information We Collect

1.1 Personal Information

We do not currently collect personal information from visitors through our Website.

The Website does not currently require you to:

  • Create an account
  • Sign in or register
  • Enter your name
  • Enter your phone number
  • Enter your email address
  • Enter your address
  • Enter payment or banking information
  • Submit an order directly to us

We therefore do not maintain a customer account database or customer order database through this Website.

1.2 Cookies and Tracking

Our Website does not currently use cookies, tracking technologies, analytics tools, advertising pixels, or similar technologies to track or profile visitors.

We do not currently use the Website to monitor your browsing activity across websites or create user profiles based on your Website activity.

If our practices change in the future, this Privacy Policy will be updated accordingly.

2. Product Information and External Marketplace Links

Our Website displays information about HerbalVan products and may provide links or buttons directing you to third-party marketplaces, including Meesho, Amazon, Flipkart or other platforms where our products may be available for purchase.

When you click one of these links and leave our Website, your interaction is with the respective third-party platform and is governed by that platform's own terms, privacy policy and practices.

HerbalVan does not receive or control the personal information you provide directly to those third-party marketplaces through their checkout or purchasing systems.

For example, if you purchase a HerbalVan product through Amazon, the information you provide during that transaction is handled according to Amazon's applicable policies and terms.

We encourage you to review the privacy policy of the relevant marketplace before providing any personal information or completing a purchase.

3. Third-Party Websites

Our Website may contain links to websites or services operated by third parties.

We do not control the privacy practices, security, content or policies of those third-party websites.

The presence of a link on our Website does not mean that HerbalVan controls, operates or is responsible for the privacy practices of that third-party website.

4. Changes to This Privacy Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy if our Website, services or data-handling practices change.

Any updated version will be published on this page with a revised “Last Updated” date.

If we introduce features such as account registration, direct purchasing, contact forms, analytics, cookies, newsletters or other methods of collecting personal information, this Privacy Policy will be updated to describe those practices before or when such features are introduced, as applicable.

5. Contact Us

If you have any questions regarding this Privacy Policy or our privacy practices, you may contact us at:

items.title: Terms of Service
items.content:

Welcome to the HerbalVan website (“Website”). The Website is operated by HerbalVan (“HerbalVan”, “we”, “us”, or “our”).

By accessing or using this Website, you agree to be bound by these Terms & Conditions (“Terms”). If you do not agree with these Terms, please do not use the Website.

1. About Our Website

HerbalVan is a product showcase and informational website.

The Website provides information about HerbalVan products, including product descriptions, ingredients, usage information, images and other related content.

We do not currently sell products directly through this Website. The Website does not provide account registration, checkout or payment processing facilities.

2. Purchasing HerbalVan Products

Products displayed on our Website may be available for purchase through third-party online marketplaces, including Meesho, Amazon, Flipkart and other platforms.

Our Website may provide links or buttons that redirect you to these platforms.

When you choose to purchase a product through a third-party marketplace:

  • The purchase is completed through the respective marketplace.
  • The marketplace's terms and conditions apply to your transaction.
  • Payment is processed through the respective marketplace or its authorised payment providers.
  • Shipping, delivery, cancellation, return and refund procedures are governed by the applicable marketplace policies and the terms applicable to your order.
  • Any personal information you provide during the purchase is handled according to the applicable marketplace's privacy policy.

Please review the terms and policies of the relevant marketplace before completing your purchase.

3. Product Information

We make reasonable efforts to ensure that the information displayed on the Website is accurate and up to date.

However, product images, colours, packaging, availability and other visual or descriptive details may vary from the actual product.

Product information may also be updated from time to time without prior notice.

The information provided on the Website is intended for general product information and should not be considered medical advice, diagnosis or treatment.

4. Product Usage

Products should be used according to the instructions provided on the product packaging or accompanying product information.

Customers are responsible for reading the product label, ingredients and usage instructions before using a product.

If you have a known allergy, sensitivity or other concern regarding any ingredient, please review the ingredient information carefully and consult an appropriate professional where necessary before use.

5. Pricing and Availability

Product prices, offers, discounts and availability displayed on third-party marketplaces may change from time to time.

HerbalVan does not guarantee that a product displayed on our Website will always be available for purchase or that the price displayed on a third-party marketplace will remain unchanged.

The applicable price and availability at the time of purchase on the respective marketplace shall apply to that transaction.

6. Third-Party Links

Our Website contains links to third-party websites and online marketplaces.

These websites are independently operated and are not controlled by HerbalVan.

We are not responsible for:

  • The availability or operation of third-party websites
  • Their content or policies

Your use of third-party websites is subject to their respective terms and policies.

Nothing in these Terms is intended to exclude or limit any liability that cannot legally be excluded or limited under applicable law.
